    - (Whispering.) Welcome to the great library, *Player*. Benedict, Head Librarian. How may I help? Quietly, please.
        - *Choice:* Tell me about the library.
        - *Choice:* Who are you?
        - *Choice:* You seem to be looking for something.
        - *Choice:* Any sign of the volume?
        - *Choice:* Goodbye.
    - The Academy's oldest treasure: Magician treatises, Commons almanacs, Savage songs, Aristocrat chronicles, gathered over centuries from all four peoples.
    - Name a book and I will have it in your hands before you finish describing it. Nearly any book.
    - I came here as a boy to fetch and shelve, and I have hardly left since. Head Librarian for thirty years. I also teach the palace's scribes to hold a pen properly.
    - [Petronella](../npcs/petronella.md), the Royal Scribe, was my best pupil. She still sends me her finest pages, and I still find one letter on each to correct. We both enjoy it.
    - A volume of the Aristocrat war chronicles. I read its first pages myself, eighteen years ago, at the desk by the window. I was called away, and when I came back it was gone.
    - I lost it. That is the part I cannot bear. I have searched every shelf every year since, and some nights I fear it left the building that same afternoon.
    - Mind the third step on your way out. It creaks, and the readers glare.
    - No. But two more pairs of eyes are watching for it now, and the lower stacks are quiet. That is more than I had last year.
